title: Cycles made only of arrays are not detected (RangeError / cycles option ignored)
property: A circular structure either throws TypeError('Converting circular structure to JSON') or, with opts.cycles true, yields '__cycle__' in place of the cycle
property_test: circular array throws TypeError or yields __cycle__
input: const a = []; a.push(a); index(a) and index(a, {cycles:true})
actual: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded in both cases
evidence: README documents the cycles option (cycle detection returns '__cycle__', otherwise TypeError as in JSON.stringify). Code only records objects in `seen` after the Array.isArray branch returns, so arrays are never tracked.
